description: Allow the gateway web UI (served from localhost into the webview) to report that it has mounted (the shell shows the window then), set its own zoom level (the interface-scale setting), open the system file picker an agent's directory/file config field uses to bind a host mount, and choose the voice output: list the PipeWire sinks and route lmgw's own playback streams to one (chat-voice §12.3). KWin draws the window frame, so the page drives no window controls.
